summary: US CENTCOM launched intensive strikes on dozens of IRGC targets across Iran in response to Iranian ballistic missile attacks on US forces, while multiple explosions rocked Ahvaz and Qeshm Island. Simultaneously, IDF operations continue in southern Lebanon against Hezbollah underground infrastructure and in Gaza against Hamas weapons caches. Regional tensions escalate with IRGC naval seizures in the Strait of Hormuz and US-Saudi joint strikes on pro-Iran militias in Iraq.
key_points: US CENTCOM conducted intensive strikes on IRGC command centers, missile facilities, and naval capabilities in Iran on July 29 after intercepting Iranian ballistic missiles targeting US forces. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86327)
At least four explosions struck Ahvaz, Khuzestan province, causing power outages in Golestan where the MOIS building is located and shaking residential windows. (Source: @shin_persian/8702)

Multiple explosions hit Qeshm Island around 3:40 AM local time, with six locals reporting blasts; rescue teams search rubble and two injured were hospitalized. (Source: @presstv/200842, @Faytuks_Network/5903)

IDF engineering vehicle hit by explosion in Ali Taher Ridge, south Lebanon; possible Hezbollah explosive drone; Hezbollah maintains underground complex near Nabatieh with dozens of operatives. (Source: @manniefabian/58884)
IDF destroyed 55-meter Hezbollah underground HQ with three living rooms under a construction factory 300m from UNIFIL building; shaft contained dozens of weapons. (Source: @inon_yttach/9720)
IRGC Navy seized three tankers in Strait of Hormuz for ignoring warnings; Iran warns US interventions will not go unanswered; UKMTO unconfirmed. (Source: @VahidOnline/77619)
IDF struck Hamas weapons warehouses in central and northern Gaza, including one inside a mosque; weapons intended for attacks on IDF forces and Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24758)
US and Saudi Arabia jointly attacked pro-Iran militias in Iraq after IRGC missile attack on US base in Jordan. (Source: @almogboker78/17845)

sections.executive_summary: US CENTCOM launched intensive strikes on dozens of IRGC targets across Iran in response to Iranian ballistic missile attacks on US forces, while multiple explosions rocked Ahvaz and Qeshm Island. Simultaneously, IDF operations continue in southern Lebanon against Hezbollah underground infrastructure and in Gaza against Hamas weapons caches. Regional tensions escalate with IRGC naval seizures in the Strait of Hormuz and US-Saudi joint strikes on pro-Iran militias in Iraq.

points: US CENTCOM conducted intensive strikes on July 29 at 10pm EST against dozens of IRGC targets in Iran including military command centers, missile and drone facilities, coastal surveillance and defense sites, and naval capabilities, in response to Iranian ballistic missile attacks on US forces the previous day; all Iranian missiles were intercepted; over 50,000 US troops in the region are on high alert. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86327)

At least four explosions struck Ahvaz, Khuzestan province, around 02:13 local time, causing power outages in the Golestan area where the MOIS building is located; residents reported severe shaking that shattered windows and woke them from sleep. (Source: @shin_persian/8702, @shin_persian/8716, @kianmeli1/90310, @rodast_omiddana/78235, @Faytuks_Network/5919)

Multiple explosions were heard on Qeshm Island in southern Iran around 3:40 AM local time; six locals reported blasts; rescue teams continue searching rubble for survivors; two injured were taken to hospital; the attacks followed reported US aggression on the island. (Source: @presstv/200842, @Faytuks_Network/5903, @presstv/200853, @naya_foriraq/86313)

IRGC Navy seized three tankers in the Strait of Hormuz for ignoring warnings; Tehran rejected the southern route via Oman's coast; IRGC stated US interventions 'will not go unanswered'; UKMTO has not confirmed the seizures. (Source: @VahidOnline/77619)
Unconfirmed reports indicate three explosions in Nurabad, Fars province (Nurabad Mamasani) at 02:19, shattering windows; details remain unverified. (Source: @VahidOnline/77627)

Wall Street Journal reports CENTCOM commander presented Trump a two-week air campaign plan to paralyze Iranian missile capabilities; expanded US strikes may draw Israel into the conflict. (Source: @SharghDaily/175195, @rodast_omiddana/78242)

US Treasury Secretary Bessent declared Iran's regime faces economic collapse with triple-digit inflation; new sanctions target individuals, companies, tankers, and networks funding IRGC; US will not allow Iran to hold global trade hostage. (Source: @VahidOnline/77625)

IDF engineering vehicle struck by explosion in the Ali Taher Ridge area of the south Lebanon buffer zone overnight; military investigating possible Hezbollah explosive drone, which would be the first such incident since the framework agreement; Hezbollah maintains a massive underground complex under the ridge near Nabatieh with dozens of operatives; IDF prevented from capturing underground passages by ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/58884)

IDF Brigade 401 and Yahalom destroyed a Hezbollah underground headquarters in south Lebanon: tunnel length approximately 55 meters with three living rooms, built under a construction materials factory roughly 300 meters from a UNIFIL building; a shaft contained dozens of weapons. (Source: @inon_yttach/9720)

IDF Division 91 continues locating and destroying Hezbollah weapons in the south Lebanon security zone; Brigades 401, 4, and 300 found AK-47s, RPGs, IEDs, grenades, magazines, and additional combat equipment; Unit 869 detected a suspect at Ras Biada, fired warning shots, then neutralized the threat after he continued approaching. (Source: @New_security8200/203050, @inon_yttach/9718)

IDF struck and destroyed several Hamas weapons warehouses in central and northern Gaza during the week; one warehouse was located inside a mosque in northern Gaza; weapons intended to target IDF forces along the yellow line and Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24758)

Three Israeli civilians crossed the border into Syria at the Hermon area; IDF located and returned them to Israel; they were transferred to Israel Police for legal proceedings. (Source: @idf_telegram/24761, @New_security8200/203062)
Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman told US Vice President Vance that Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman seeks to de-escalate with Iran, contrary to Netanyahu's position. (Source: @N12chat/219864)
US and Saudi Arabia conducted joint strikes on pro-Iran militias in Iraq following IRGC missile attack on a US base in Jordan. (Source: @almogboker78/17845)

IDF Southern Command forces remain deployed in Gaza per the agreement and will continue acting to remove all threats. (Source: @idf_telegram/24758)
